messages:
Sam: Quick idea — prune the policy DSL to three primitives: affinity, capacity, penalty. Too many knobs are making routing outcomes unpredictable.
Anya: +1. We should explicitly split affinity (soft preference) vs capacity (hard limit). Today affinity is being used as a hack for capacity and it complicates runtime.
Jordan: If we separate them then runtime needs preemption/lease semantics for hard capacity. That will touch the scheduler and request lifecycle.
Kai: @Jordan yep. Minimal change path: introduce `capacity.max_concurrency` and `capacity.lease_timeout`. Map old `weight` -> `penalty` by default so legacy policies keep behavior.
Maria: We'll need telemetry added: label route decisions with reason tags like `reason=capacity|latency|region`. Also an opt-in migration flag so we can compare outcomes without impacting traffic.
Lee: Migration idea: canary per-tenant. Add `compat_mode: true` that applies mapping but logs when the new model would pick a different route.
Sam: Sketch of proposed schema:
```json
{
  "route": "model-a",
  "affinity": { "region": "us-west", "soft_score": 0.7 },
  "capacity": { "max_concurrency": 50, "lease_timeout_ms": 2000 },
  "penalty": { "cost_multiplier": 1.0 }
}
```
Jordan: Tie-breaker note — we must be deterministic for rollout stability. Suggest `hash(tenant_id, route_id, seed)` as final comparator.
Kai: Also add an explicit `latency_slack_ms` threshold so runtime can prefer cheaper variants if measured latency < slack.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled for tomorrow 10:30 UTC :rocket:
Maria: I'll add dashboards: `route_policy_mismatch`, `route_choice_delta_count`, and per-tenant `fallback_rate`. Also will surface `reason` breakdown in the route SLO pane.
Sam: Action items: PR for schema (owner: Sam), runtime adapter change ticket (owner: Kai), telemetry/dashboard PR (owner: Maria), migration plan doc (owner: Lee). Sync tomorrow 11am UTC. :thumbsup:
Kai: I'll own the adapter, will post perf sketch by EOD next Wed.
Lee: I'll draft migration playbook and compat-mode instrumentation today.
Maria: Noted. I'll wire up logs to BigQuery and add alert thresholds for unexpected choice deltas.
Sam: Thanks all — keeping this tight will make runtime behavior more predictable and the migration safer.
